investigation_scope: ISRO Earth Observation & Geospatial Web Services Compliance
summary: VARUNA 2047 conducted a systematic technical audit of ISRO Bhuvan, VEDAS, MOSDAC, and Bhoonidhi services. ISRO Bhuvan Open Vector WMS is verified as active and accessible for map overlays. Furthermore, official ISRO thematic layers (sisdpv2:TS_Warangal_lulc_v2 for SISDP-2 Land Use / Land Cover and gw:TELANGANA_PRE for RGNDWM Ground Water Prospects) were discovered in the GetCapabilities document and verified via live GetMap requests (HTTP 200). For full-resolution multi-decadal raster pixel processing, ISRO Bhoonidhi requires user-authenticated batch ordering with CAPTCHA tokens; therefore, analytical GeoTIFF rasters in VARUNA 2047 are biophysical simulations generated for engine testing and clearly disclosed as simulations.

services.description: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) Official WMS providing Indian base layers, administrative boundaries, and thematic cartography.
services.intended_use: Base map cartography, district contextualization, national geospatial alignment.
services.technical_limitation_notes: Public WMS endpoint permits live map tile rendering without API credentials. Verified layers include SISDP Land Use/Cover and Ground Water Prospects. Bulk raw scene GeoTIFF downloads require authenticated Bhoonidhi SSO sessions.

services.description: Land Use / Land Cover 1:50,000 national agricultural and vegetation classification maps.
services.intended_use: Agricultural land cover validation and crop area verification.
services.technical_limitation_notes: HTTP 404 returned during discovery check; thematic layers are instead accessed via bhuvan-vec1.

services.description: Space Applications Centre (SAC) thematic portal for vegetation monitoring, desertification, and agricultural drought indices.
services.intended_use: Agricultural drought assessment, seasonal NDVI anomalies.
services.technical_limitation_notes: HTTP 404 returned during direct WMS check.

services.description: Meteorological and oceanographic data from INSAT-3D, INSAT-3DR, and SCATSAT satellites.
services.intended_use: Real-time satellite precipitation estimates and ocean surface winds.
services.technical_limitation_notes: Portal page returned HTTP 200; WMS GetCapabilities requires specific subsystem tokens or redirect.

services.description: Open data dissemination portal for Resourcesat, Cartosat, and Oceansat data.
services.technical_limitation_notes: Portal page returned HTTP 200; direct programmatic tile ingestion is blocked by SSO and CAPTCHA.
